definitions.gloss: to be put off; to be turned off; to recoil
definitions.explanation: To feel strongly repelled or uncomfortable because of someone's words or actions.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ドン{引|び}きだ。
examples.english: That comment really turned me off.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ドン{引|び}き⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Everyone was put off by his behavior.

notes:
ドン{引|び}き combines ドン (emphatic prefix from onomatopoeia) + ⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ (to draw back). It expresses a strong negative reaction of being repelled or disgusted.

REGISTER:
This is casual slang popular among younger speakers. In formal contexts, use ⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ or ⟦{嫌悪感|けんおかん}→嫌悪感：15749_kenokan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}く→抱く：02010_idaku⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ドン{引|び}き⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be put off
- ドン{引|び}きだ: that's a turn-off
- ドン{引|び}き⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to put someone off
